notes: SOURCE: INPS Circolare n. 9 del 3 febbraio 2026 — contributi lavoro domestico 2026.
INFO: Domestic sector uses flat per-hour contributions (domestic_contributions); the standard 'inps' and 'apprentice' blocks are absent.
INFO: fixed_term_additional_rate retained for informational purposes; the addizionale NASpI is pre-baked into employer_per_hour_fixed_term in domestic_contributions.
SIMPLIFICATION: CUAF variant (senza CUAF) not modelled; 'con CUAF' amounts used throughout.
SIMPLIFICATION: IRPEF figures are informational only — family employers are not sostituti d'imposta (Art. 4 D.P.R. 600/1973). Set withholding_exempt: true in the CCNL JSON to zero irpef_net.

Sterilizzazione detrazioni: Art. 1 c. 3-4 L. 199/2025 — for reddito complessivo > EUR 200 000, total detrazioni (Art. 12 + Art. 13 TUIR) reduced by EUR 440 (clawback of the 35% -> 33% bracket benefit on the 28 000-50 000 slice).

Somma esente (L. 207/2024): band cut points 8 500 EUR and 15 000 EUR are reconstructions from worked examples — not verified against primary source. Rates 7.1%/5.3%/4.8% and ceiling 20 000 EUR are from AdE guidance.
